_comment: Copy this to run-config.json (gitignored) and edit before each eval run.
_note: Config precedence (lowest to highest): built-in defaults → run-config.json → args passed to Workflow().

samplesByScenario._comment: Override N for specific scenarios. Remove this key to use 'samples' for all.

_fields.scenarios: REQUIRED. Array of short scenario names (e.g. 'SC-01-duplicate-race') or absolute paths. NEVER omit — the runner throws if absent.
_fields.samples: Default N per scenario (answers per arm). Default: 3.
_fields.samplesByScenario: Per-scenario N overrides. Map of short-name -> N. Takes priority over 'samples'.
_fields.skillDir: Absolute path to the skill directory. Default: <repo>/skill.
_fields.useCachedRed: If true, load RED verdicts from evals/baselines/<name>.json (skip RED arm agents). Default: false.
_fields.agentModel: Model for RED+GREEN answer agents. Default: 'sonnet'.
_fields.judgeModel: Model for batch-judge + scorecard agents. Default: 'haiku'.
_fields.confirmLargeRun: Set to true to allow runs where expectedAgents > 120. Default: false (safety ceiling).
